text: いちど　ちゃんと　はなしが　してみたいぜ！

structure.jp: はなしが　してみたいぜ！
structure.en: I'd like to try having a talk!

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means to try doing it and see what it's like. してみたい = 'I want to try doing'

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says you want to do it; the thing wanted can take が in place of を. はなしが　してみたい = 'I want to try having a talk'

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky male speech that adds punch to what was said. してみたいぜ = 'I'd sure like to try, man!'
